asr.full_text: Hello, here is the action point of Friday 22 September 2017. BNP Paribas stock has been well oriented since the beginning of the month. Yesterday, the rise in bond rates has helped to support the growth of the banking sector. The action that was around 67 euros yesterday could try to exceed this level. and to test again the highest since October 2008 at 68.87.
